in_marathi.name: Moti
in_marathi.long_meaning: Moti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Moti is the name of the goddess of wealth, Lakshmi, who is symbolized by the pearl. The name Moti signifies abundance, prosperity, and good fortune.
